I had a sudden toothache with no signs of decay. We visited 5 clinics, and all of them had appointments in 3-4 days. We stopped by this clinic on the way. Between appointments, the doctor agreed to see me, we did a full CT scan of my jaw, and the doctor was very competent. He said it was an infection. They gave me a full course of pills right there. The place is modest, but the staff is very friendly. The doctor has a ton of international diplomas, and he simply saved my vacation and my tooth. I will recommend this place to everyone, because it was the only place where I got quick help without any fuss. Dr. Jimmy, you are my hero! Very reasonable prices, for the work, and not because we are tourists.
